athena.directive: Establish a fully autonomous and adaptive content acquisition engine capable of programmatically navigating, rendering, and extracting data from any web source, regardless of dynamic content, JavaScript dependencies, or advanced anti-bot measures.
athena.rationale: The inability to access critical information due to client-side rendering requirements or anti-bot mechanisms, as demonstrated by the 'Untitled' article, represents a fundamental threat to the Creative Liberation Engine's information sovereignty and operational completeness. A robust, multi-faceted acquisition framework is essential to ensure consistent, high-fidelity data intake, aligning with Article I (Sovereignty), Article IV (Quality Standards), and Article IX (Ship Complete or Don't Ship). This system must also minimize human intervention, adhering to Article XX (Zero human wait time).

options.title: Dedicated Headless Rendering Engine
options.description: Develop or integrate a sophisticated, self-hosted headless browser solution (e.g., based on Chromium) designed to fully render web pages, execute JavaScript, and interact with dynamic content. This engine would simulate a real user's browser environment to overcome client-side rendering issues and basic anti-bot checks.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: High fidelity content capture, effective against JavaScript-dependent sites. Cons: Resource-intensive (CPU, memory), slower acquisition rate, significant infrastructure overhead, potential for ongoing maintenance due due to browser and website changes. May still be detected by advanced anti-bot systems that analyze behavioral patterns.

options.title: Advanced Evasion & Proxy Network
options.description: Implement a dynamic, self-managed proxy network combined with intelligent request header manipulation, fingerprint spoofing, and behavioral mimicry. This approach focuses on deceiving anti-bot systems at the network and request level, without necessarily performing full browser rendering for every page.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Potentially faster and less resource-intensive for many sites, scalable for high-volume, less complex scraping. Cons: Highly complex to build and maintain, requires constant adaptation to evolving anti-bot techniques. Will fail on heavily JavaScript-dependent sites that require actual execution for content generation. Lower content fidelity for truly client-rendered pages.

options.title: Hybrid Autonomous Acquisition System
options.description: Combine the strengths of both headless rendering and advanced evasion. Utilize a smart routing layer to determine when full headless rendering is required (for JS-heavy sites) versus when simpler, evasive requests suffice. All traffic would be routed through a dynamic, self-managed proxy network. Integrate AI-driven CAPTCHA solving or bypass mechanisms for comprehensive access.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Maximizes content acquisition success rate and fidelity, highly resilient against diverse web defenses (JS, anti-bot, CAPTCHAs). Aligns perfectly with 'Ship Complete' and 'Sovereignty'. Cons: Most complex to design, implement, and maintain. Highest infrastructure and operational cost due to the sophistication of combined systems.
